A cozy, bohemian hotel, with a beach almost right next to the hotel, free sunbeds, beautiful bohemian umbrellas on the beach, poufs, and loungers. Rooms have a fridge and kettle. Everything is very close, with a Migros store opposite the hotel, and buses to the city from the Migros store. A lovely promenade, the sea is spotlessly clean. The food is delicious. Free drinks with breakfast, juices, coffee, and tea. Free tea with dinner, but other drinks are available for a fee. Very friendly and helpful staff. The chill-out music on the beach is nice, not too loud. If you don't need marble and gold, this is a great hotel, and the location is perfect.

Myself and my friend booked this as we was looking for a cheap and cheerful get away, this hotel was definitely not a cheerful experience The hotel is actually the worst hotel I’ve ever stayed in, Absolutely unsanitary living conditions. This hotel felt like something out of Fawlty Towers — chaotic, poorly maintained, and far below expectations. I honestly wouldn’t even give it 1 star. The staff aren’t even friendly or helpful, throughout our whole stay we found probably 3 members of staff who were decent The only positives were the beach right outside, the convenient location, and the lovely cats and dogs around the property. The beds were also comfortable. Unfortunately, everything else was a major disappointment. The food was disgusting to the point that we had to eat out for every meal during our stay. We gave it multiple chances and tried eating there on three separate occasions, thinking surely at least one meal would be enjoyable, but every experience was poor. So we ended up spending more money eating out Even the cutlery was visibly unclean, which only added to the feeling of poor hygiene throughout the hotel. Without question, this is the worst hotel I’ve ever stayed in. Save your money and book somewhere else.

Great location by the beach. The hotel play very, very loud music on the beach, like being in a disco, so if you're looking for a peaceful day on the beach, give this hotel a miss. The bar prices are very expensive too. The breakfast cater for the Turkish guests, there's also cold chips and onion rings left over from the previous evening, some mornings not even a bpiled egg. Coffee machine but no English tea, better bring your own tea bags if you prefer a cup of tea in the morning The evening meal is almost the same each day, chicken thighs and wings, rice and occasionally potato wedges, the salads are the best meal, always fresh. The management aren't interested in the guests, they don't go out their way to speak or ask if everything's OK, they just aren't bothered.

We knew the hotel as we stayed along from it last time. Here's our feedback: PROs LOCATION: Beautiful vibe, set under Eucalyptus trees. Beach hotel. CLEANLINESS OUTSIDE: Great. Swept & reset for each new day ROOM: Decent double room with sofa area. Not luxury but was fine. ROOM CLEANING: Lovely team daily housekeeping couldn't fault them. BED: Huge bed, comfortable enough AC: Brilliant a/c much needed in 36 degrees STAFF: Really lovely bunch who looked after us. Very hard working FAVOURITES: Love that you can sit under trees for drinks & there is a bohemian lounging area by beach & the outdoor restaurant - all so lovely BEACH SET UP: Sunbeds literally on the shore, waiter-service for drinks, easy access to the sea. CONs FOOD: Overall it spoilt our holiday and turned our stomach. We had half-board breakfast & dinner (both buffets). First impressions it looks like a nice enough offering but it is not. BREAKFAST: Catering for Turkish tastes only: Coffee machine: average, weak machine coffee Juice: fake sweet orange drink from powder full of chemicals (tang?) Cold buffet options: olives, salad, spam, curdled yoghurt + 5 uncovered, catering bowls of honey & jams put back out each day (after they've fished the spam out that someone dropped in), processed cheese Hot buffet options: overcooked chips, hard boiled eggs (no option to have eggs cooked any other way), cold slices of omelette on occasion, spam chipolatas (on occasion). I did like: tomatoes with cheese on (served twice) & the sliced fresh cheese & the watermelon slices & dried fig. Also pancakes (served twice) DINNER: Yoghurt dips that were reserved every day and not made freshly. Couscous salad served twice, meaning they put it out at beginning of week and then end of week (same dish) I did like: Fresh tomatoes & cucumber salad We loved: their rice, every night a different type & it was really good. Hot buffet options: awful concoctions and we're not fussy eaters. Just a few options each evening such as: Left over poor quality meat mixed in with aubergine Chicken drumsticks in sauce that tasted unfresh DESSERTS You can't say they don't have a lot of variety here, they offer at least 10 different desserts. But it is basically Mum's gone to Iceland, pink icing type things for kids. SUMMARY Food isn't fresh (apart from salad which is lovely) They serve it until they then put it in a random dish Very few hot choices No hot choices for non-meat eaters No seafood or fish at all (they are running it on a very low food budget) We paid to eat out elsewhere a few nights. We also paid to upgrade to eat their sunday a la carte which was nice. We don't understand how they can get everything else so right but mess up the food so much. A little more budget and creativity and it could be ok.

We did not stay in the hotel but we went there twice for the day and ate there and used their wonderful hippy chill out area with soft colourful cushions and hammocks. It is such a lovely relaxing place! We also used the sunbeds which are padded, cosy and sit right on the sea. There is a carpet to walk out on over the stones into the sea which was greatly appreciated. Beautiful views. Hussein and his team were super friendly and helpful and the food was great - I recommend the baby spinach salad with blue cheese and walnuts! Lovely place and we would definitely recommend for those days when you really want to relax. They also have water sports available but we did not use them.

Had the best holiday at okaliptus hotel, such friendly staff ,Huseyin and the team where amazing treated us like family. We will definitely go back next year. Rooms cleaned and towels changed every day. Amazing food at outside restaurant. Rick and Jane xx (Also known as Michael and Susan )

Hotel is right on the beach in a beautiful spot. The rooms are basic but adequate. Just a little bit of TLC required. Safe wasn’t working but was fixed immediately. Patio doors weren’t locking but again fixed right away. The food wasn’t up too much. Two hot options at breakfast and two at night. Basic things like chicken thighs and meatballs. Chefs standing watching everyone at night which was very off putting. Visited here 10 years ago and they served pancakes and omelettes made freshly. There was a large grill outside which was never used. So all in all I would say ideal spot but food badly letting them down. Chips at breakfast 🙄

The best part about this hotel is its private beach. The hotel is clean and the staff are friendly. The rooms are comfortable but there’s no WiFi in the rooms and they can do with a renovation. It’s not like things are falling apart, they are not but the the decor belongs to another era. The hotel is half board (breakfast/dinner incl.) The breakfast buffet is very good but the dinner buffet is more limited does not have very tasty choices. However, somehow when the lunch food (not included in the half board price so you pay extra) is really delicious! It’s as if there are two different chefs for lunch and dinner. There’s a minibus that goes to the Bodrum city center that you can get on from in front of the hotel. It’s really well located and Bitez has one of the cleanest beaches in Turkey.

What an absolute gem this hotel proved to be. Set back in a beautiful stone walled setting. You will find picture perfect arches with ornate potted trees and hanging flowers and climbing roses on your way to the reception point. The pool has an abundance of mature eucalyptus trees nestled around it and has high quality sunloungers with comfortable thick seat cushions that will satisfy anybody even those with mobility issues. The sand shingle beach is only a few steps away and a special long matting has been fitted into the sea making walking into bath a doddle. There are hammocks, thick cushioned swing chairs, sunloungers with parosals from the moment you hit the beach.we found this both relaxing and tranquil and spent alot of our time here during our day. The food at the restaurant was really good. Breakfast had lots of choice but please be aware this is more a continental Mediterranean affair, as is the evening meal. But if you are into your turkish/Greek type food you will love it. If you decide to eat in the outdoor restaurant you will not be disappointed the food is the best quality and the salmon pizza and huge burgers are above expectations. Our room had a brand new thick comfortable mattress, power shower and the storage was good. Fridge was good size and room cleaned daily. All the staff are happy to help and management take an interest if you have questions. We will definitely be coming back here again, the hotel is not massive but the ambience, the service and the whole experience was

Stayed here on 3 occasions over past 3 years, would not allow last Sept as option on review. First time 3 years ago the staff were really friendly and management helpful, only concern then was food was poor and they did not explain that drink IE-Coffee or tea were not inclusive with half board cost so this was added on every breakfast time-which we felt was non transparent. Second stay was same, food not great and cold most evenings. We noted they give different treatment to people stopping by off the beach to order food and the standard of that is far better. Do not stay half board as you will end up eating out. It is on a great part of beach and the pillows and hammocks scattered everywhere on their part of the beach and live dj through the day make it a nice place to be to relax and soak up the sun through the day. The pool area is over grown and not much room for loungers either. Quite unsafe for elderly or young children around pool due to loungers almost touching edge of poolside making it difficult to walk round without risk of falling in. Drinks are very expensive, over priced cocktails too. Third stay of Sept 23...was an utter disgrace. My key would not work and I would have to ask reception to let me back into my room every time I had been anywhere (long walk from reception) they were rude about it and told me they needed a part, asked to be moved rooms and they declined. In the end they made excuse I had not been in room for them to fix the lock (why would I need to be?) A beach towel went missing and half a bottle of Gin as well out of room, totally not bothered when I advised reception who said they did not understand what I was saying. The final straw amongst other issues was room was above water pump to hotel grounds so I ended up with lack of sleep every night, gushing noise and pumping noises all night long.Then to be advised on check out of a bill for drinks which had drinks on it that I had not ordered! I refused to pay what we had not ordered and the manager insisted we pay, we refused and went through bill to highlight what had been bought. Eventually giving in he amended the bill. Take your own water or stop by at a shop if you arrive late too as they don't even offer a drink if you arrive on a late flight nor put water in the fridge. Such a shame, I had really enjoyed the first two stays here only to be let down by bad management at last stay and it left me never to wishing to stay here again. Great location but do not be fooled by the tranquil images, unless they review and do a major overhaul to how they treat guests they will lose repeat revenue. I never wished to leave bad review and raved about this place the first two times but if you look forward to going on holiday to be treated badly it really does make you feel really negative about somewhere. Found much nicer hotels now in Bitez due to being a frequent visitor and after speaking to other people they too have decided not to revisit the Okaliptus.

The hotel rooms are spacious. The bed was comfortable. There was a decent walk in shower. We asked at reception on the first morning for a plug for the sink as my husband has a wet shave.Housekeeping was hit and miss. Some days not cleaned. Other days shower mat missing. The toilet was broken the seat moved when you sat down. By the end of the holiday it was completely detached. There was a distinct aroma in the bathroom which was unpleasant. We stayed for 14 nights. The bed was only changed 2 days before we came home. There was a fridge . The freezer compartment was completely iced up. We went half board. Food was never hot. You needed to get there when the restaurant opened as the buffet was hardly ever replenished. We spent most of our time around the pool. It was so peaceful until the thump thump of the music in the afternoon The groundsman did a good job.

My first trip to Turkey. It won't be my last and the hotel is absolutely fabulous. At the time we went to them it was quiet and that than it would be mid season. Really enjoyed our stay and will certainly go back. next year and I am really, really looking forward to it next year and I am really, really looking forward to it

Fabulous location right on Bitez beach. Great for us staying in a ground floor room, we had the pleasure of a couple of minutes walk on one level to the well-cared for beach beds or pool. Plenty of seating areas to relax in. Lovely pool with plenty of sunbeds. The room was tired, as other visitors have commented, and the cleanliness left a lot to be desired - our room could have done with a thorough clean. We had breakfast and dinner - both buffet style, plenty of food - but they started to clear away earlier than expected, so don’t leave it too late to eat! Overall we’d stay there again as the location is lovely, fabulous beach.

Don't sometimes even move pillows on beds.toilets not properly cleaned just squirt cleaning agent in.the toilet roll holder has not ever been cleaned properly and the skirting in shower has not been painted for years looks very shabby.durson the owner is far more pleasant this year and seems to interact more with his guests.his brothers have no manners and wouldn't even say hello to you even though you are coming for years.as for the loud boom boom music in bar restaurant and beach it's horrendous and every one complains to no avail.the one time said to me it was to keep people awake so they would buy drinks.!!!!!!.I still come to this hotel as its the best spot on the beach but they need to hire more staff for room cleaning.i only see three women doing all the work.

Wasn’t sure what to expect but pleasantly surprised. Room was large basic but comfy. Balcony was fab. Externally could do with some tlc but was clean. Positioned right on the beach. Breakfast was basic and very hit & miss!!

Nice and quiet great location and breakfast and dinner excellent lots of choice only negative was drinks in Turkey very expensive now but not the hotels fault due to new tax hike on alcohol we also visited a barbers five minutes away and had an amazing massage for only £25 at Sun Kuafor well worth a visit we also visited Ambrosia Hotel for a massage by Indonesian staff for €65 not at good as Sun Kuafor

Nice hotel great as on the beach and a pool . Stayed b n b breakfast was OK always found something. Some staff friendly some didn't understand English. Prices not to bad . Negatives the owner talking to staff and ordering them about in front of guest was not nice to see. No room to change or shower for late flights home. Was told have cold shower by the pool not good enough when you fly at midnight. So I won't be back was a nice holiday but to many negatives for me

This is a lovely hotel - great location, staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful. The design of the hotel was quaint with all rooms opening up into external courtyards and corridors. Food was good and the rooms nice. There were so many options to relax - daybeds, hammocks, swings, cushions arranged around the trees, loungers. it was right beside the beach and very central in the resort. This was my first time in Turkey and I will definitely return. highly recommend this resort and hotel.

Very disappointing that it became impossible to stay on beach or anywhere near the vicinity of hotel as the club beach techno music took over, it completely destroyed our experience of staying there and what’s even more frustrating the DJ didn’t care! As he watched people leaving! This is NO WAY to run a business especially when majority of guests are mature adults and are looking forward to relaxing. Beach club techno loud music was so INAPPROPRIATE and drove us all away everyday , for that reason alone I would not return, management seem so out of touch with the guests feedback on this matter and continued to ignore everyone’s complaints, not good way to run a business! Only way I would ever return would be if no beach club music was played…. So unecessary and fully destroyed holiday experience!

This is the second time I stayed in Okalyptus, last time was 6 years ago. The hotel still have a lovely atmosphere but: the rooms really need a face-lift. The years have made its marks. Also, in 2024 I expect to have wi-fi in the rooms, not only in general areas. The staff was not very friendly and spoke little or no english. Dinner was very good but we don't like icecold red wine. The biggest problem was the music on the beach! EXTREMELY loud tecno/clubmusic everywhere! It was hard to have a conversation. The general public was in their middle age or older, I don't think annyone enjoyed it. Although I spoke to the DJ and the staff nothing was done to reduce the volyme of the musik. Unfortunately this will make me stay in another hotel next time.

This hotel deserves much more than 2 stars, great location..the staff are lovely, the rooms are fine, nice pool and food unexpectedly good. Lovely fresh salads and vegetables. It's best feature is the great relaxing beachside area, cushions and swing seats and outside dining area by the beach. I would happily spend all day there, reading and swimming and ordering food and drink. BUT I was constantly driven away by the relentless pounding disco club music blaring away all day. I can put up with background music but this is club level impossible to ignore and there is no escape. The speakers are everywhere, on the beach , by the pool, in the outdoor dining area which would otherwise be idyllic. When I politely asked staff if it could be turned down even a little, they looked embarrassed and muttered that they would try. To no effect. Most of my fellow guests were, let's say, on the nature side. Why on earth would the hotel think they want music so loud all day relaxing on the beach that you would find it hard to read, think or talk. The problem I suspect may be that the bar/dining area has a separate manager to the hotel and he thinks he is running a rave club in Ibiza. Please could the hotel address this aspect of their guests' experience so it can get the 5 stars it deserves.
Great location…Great property…Hotel needs a serious upgrade.

This is a gem of a hotel set in an oasis of greenery, that’s in the best position on Bitez Bay. Beautiful rooms, excellent care and service & professionally managed. What more could you want? I highly recommend.

This hotel was a pleasant surprise, it has comfortable and pleasant facilities, its rooms are spacious, clean and have everything you need. It is in front of a very beautiful beach and has a comfortable and sufficient beach infrastructure. Their food is good and varied. Their staff is very friendly and effective. It is a highly recommended place with an adequate price.

The hotel is not up to 4 star standards. It needs renovation because it is poorly maintained. No hot water late in the evening or in the morning because of solar energy. On the other hand, the place is beautiful because it is by the sea and in a garden. Food is average. No wifi in the rooms.

A very charming hotel - great atmosphere, tasty food and perfect service - nice music in the background (appropriate to the time of day). And the zone with pillows in front of the PETARDA beach - WE HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!! Wifi basically works throughout the entire hotel.

I was in August with a friend so it would take a book to list all the negative things, the only thing I can say is that it is a structure located in the greenery but it should be demolished and everything done new including staff,

If you are in Bodrum Stay away from this hotel. Old and dilapidated structure, dirty and staff incapable of dealing with guests. Old and dirty rooms, broken sheets and towels. Rusty and badly damaged taps. Even though the room was cleaned daily for 2 days, no staff was seen in charge of the task. After complaints and a card placed on the door - redo the room -, the housekeeper came by for the "cleaning". One day he didn't leave toilet paper, one day he didn't put towels, one day he didn't put shower mat.... In one week we spent more time at the reception requesting basic things than in the room. Corridors with things set aside for the entire week, such as fruit plates removed from the room, empty bottles, empty toilet paper cards! Another sore point is the kitchen and waiters. Buffet breakfast and dinner. Salty and not very sweet breakfast, terrible display of food, even milk left in cardboard bags (not even a jug or a dispenser). Dinner for a week was always the same dishes (certainly also reheated and never fresh): chicken nuggets. Never rice, never fish, never cheese, little variety of raw vegetables. No labels to know the contents of the trays. Rude waiters, they slide your plate from under you while you are still eating on the plate itself. They don't change tablecloths unless specifically requested, they remove crumbs with the previous customer's hands and tell you to sit down! Last morning we even found "butterflies" in the breakfast cereals. Very small beach, 2 rows of sunbeds, the first almost in the water, the second attached immediately behind. Staff at the reception (2 people in the whole week) annoyed to stay in that place and therefore for every question or request they respond badly, the meaning is a little.... don't bother me that I necessarily have to stay here! The only kind, nice, hospitable and professional person is the assistant manager Sauney, who is really the only positive note of this place which I obviously DO NOT RECOMMEND to everyone. I attach some "indecent" photos!

I stayed in this hotel for a week, the corner with the colorful cushions close to the beach was nice and the location was good. Once these two things are removed there is nothing left to save. They had guaranteed three single beds but wanted to give us a double bed with an extra bed; after much insistence we prevailed. Cleanliness is poor, the taps in the bathroom are old and not very functional. Sheets torn and not very clean. Poor breakfast, mostly salty. Buffet dinner, with fixed menu: chicken, some side dishes and yogurt sauces. For those who don't eat meat there is no alternative. The dishes are not labeled; one evening, when I asked a waiter what was on a tray, he literally sent me to hell, screaming. The waiters literally take away the plate in front of you, even if you are still eating. In short, dinner is not exactly a moment of relaxation in this hotel! The only really kind and professional person is Mr. Sunay. Conclusion: considering the rude staff and the hygienic-structural conditions, I would not return nor recommend it.

Points positifs: emplacement directement à la plage, jardin ombragé dans l’enceinte de l’hôtel. Wifi correct mais pas en chambre. Petite piscine mais correcte. Service de serviette pour la plage ou piscine gratuit et même sans caution à l’hôtel…de nombreux clients ne se privent pas de les reprendre quand ils quittent l’hôtel. Facilités et nombreux restaurants autour (ce qui n’est pas négligeable vu la médiocrité de la restauration proposée à l’hôtel… Points négatifs : 1) chambre à la limite de la propreté. Notre sale de bain était crasseuse, La climatisation ne fonctionnait pas dans notre chambre et avons dû attendre 4 jours pour être changé de chambre suite à nos nombreuses plaintes auprès de l’hôtel qui mettait en cause notre non savoir faire dans son utilisation. Le cinquième jour une société extérieure est venu une journée entière pour les réparations……. Électricité qui sauté du à une bouilloire défectueuse et un frigo qui surchauffait… Moustiquaires trouées Point positif des chambres, c’est au calme ….oufffg 2) N’espérez pas prendre votre café du petit déjeuner sur votre transat à la plage, le personnel vous réprimande alors qu’à 8h du matin il n’y a personne. Bref atteinte à votre seul bonheur du matin. 3) nourriture (si on peut appeler ça de la nourriture) à la limite du mangeable. N’espérez pas savoir ce que vous mangez rien n’est indiqué sur ce que vous pourriez vous servir au buffet. Malgré tout, le petit déjeuner est passable et permet de se caler pour la journée…ouf… 4) le prix des boissons servies à l’hôtel est une honte. 380 livres la simple bière, vendue 250 le snack d’à côté, 190 au restaurant dans la rue et 125 au magasin Migros en face de l’hôtel. Et n’espérez pas prendre votre consommation de l’extérieur, c’est interdit d’apporter à la plage de l’hôtel. À la limite une bouteille d’eau est tolérée….et encore on vous regarde étrangement. 5) petite plage où sont installés des transats les uns sur les autres recouverts de trop nombreux parasols. On vous indique une plage de sable fin, mais prenez tout de même des sandales adaptées car de nombreux galets sont présents en bord et dans l’eau. 6) la réception…une simple table et un ordinateur mais là la Clim fonctionne correctement… 7) le bar…..nous n’y avons pris que trois fois une consommation (vu les prix) mais d’une lenteur que même un escargot irait plus vite sans oublier qu’ils « oublient » la moitié des consommations commandées (nous étions à deux)… Cet établissement 4 étoiles ne reflète en aucun cas la Turquie et son accueil, n’y allez pas tout simplement. Comme nous l’a dit notre hôtesse de voyage, ils ont une étoile car directement à la plage , une étoile car c’est considéré comme un club (il y a un DJ qui vous met de la musique de 10h à 23h parfois assourdissante même) mais où sont les deux autres étoiles ??????

Eigenlijk zou dit hotel 5 sterren moeten krijgen maar helaas, bij het buffet en de vriendelijkheid gaat het mis. Op het eerste gezicht is dit hotel top. Supermooie locatie, misschien wel de mooiste locatie van Bitez. Prachtig, romantisch straatje waar de kamers aanzitten. Mooie grote maar vooral ook schone kamers. Strand op steenworp afstand. Dagelijks schoonmaak en nieuwe handdoeken. Het gaat echter mis bij het buffet restaurant. Ik zeg vooral bij het buffet omdat dit zoooo slecht is. Je begint met een simpel ontbijtbuffet met elke dag dezelfde dingen en soms wat friet....... Het gaat vooral om de avond. Hier heb je keuze uit kip en rijst of rijst en kip. Variatie is er niet. De kwaliteit is niet erg goed, vaak koud of te droog. Het is allemaal erg goedkoop voedsel. Drinken is niet inbegrepen, zelfs geen chemisch sapje uit een apparaat. Je mag water pakken, als het apparaat het tenminste doet... Drinken kopen in dit hotel is 2x zo duur als elders. 120 lira voor een cola (€ 3,22). Het terras bestaat uit 2 delen, het buffet gedeelte welke achterin zit, en het ala cart gedeelte welke aan de boulevard zit. Vaak is het buffet gedeelte vol, dan moet je maar uitzoeken waar je je eten opeet. En als je dan ziet wat er in het ala cart wordt geserveerd. Wow, en dat smaakt ook zoveel beter. Ook perfecte service hier van Charli en yasar. Wat een verschil. Dus, okaliptus, doen of niet doen. Ik zeg niet doen, er zijn meerdere leuke en betere hotels te vinden. Hie alleen een keer gaan eten bij Charli en yasar.
